STEM.value: You grow toward a light you can't prove yet, and never stop to rest under it.
You find a way around what stops other people, and they call it luck.
You warm whoever stands near you, and run on warmth nobody returns.
What you turn toward gets all of you, and everything else waits in the dark.
You hold what others set down, and nothing has ever offered to hold you.
Everything you tend grows, and the harvest goes home in other people's hands.
You say what others soften, then quietly pay for being the one who did.
You hold your work to a standard nobody set, and it never says finished.
You understand more than you can explain, and live with the distance that leaves.
You soak up what everyone around you feels, then wonder which of it is yours.
